observations: Photo 0 shows three retail boxes for Canon PIXMA G3470 printers stacked vertically.
The boxes feature the Canon logo and 'PIXMA G3470' model name.
Text on the boxes indicates 'MegaTank', 'Wireless', 'Print', 'Copy', 'Scan', and 'Zero cartridge'.
The boxes appear to be for the black color variant.
The actual printers are not visible, only the packaging.

claims.claim: Functions Wi-Fi, Print, Scan, Copy and Cloud

claims.evidence: The full specification list is not legible on the box in the photo.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain a different, older, or damaged item.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer outside the box with a handwritten note of today's date.

risks.risk: The printer may be non-functional or have clogged print heads.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a nozzle check pattern.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual printer outside the box.
Video of the printer performing a test print or nozzle check.
Photo of the serial number on the printer itself.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the retail packaging. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/unverified) until the contents and condition are proven.
